description: One contract: the product line, group and programme a lead is stamped with, and the fields that may be sent.

fields.label: Contract Name
fields.description: A short, descriptive name for this contract. Two contracts may share one product line, so the name is what tells them apart.

fields.label: Partner User
fields.description: The partner login this contract belongs to. Leave blank for an internal contract, such as one an intake form uses.

fields.label: Internal (per-grain visibility contract)
fields.description: Marks this as an internal visibility contract rather than a partner key. Allowed Fields then means the fields an internal user in that product line and group may see.

fields.label: Routing (Product Line and Group are always stamped; Source and Programme only when set below)
Source
fields.description: Pin this contract to one source, stamped on every lead and the sender's own value ignored. Leave blank to keep the source the sender puts on each lead — a value this site has not seen before is recorded as sent, never refused.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: Pin this contract to one programme, applied to every lead. Leave blank to let the sender choose from the allowed programmes.

fields.label: Allowed Programs
fields.description: Used only when Programme above is blank. The programmes this contract may set.

fields.label: Program Optional At Create
fields.description: Used only when Programme above is blank. On, a lead may arrive with no programme and have one chosen later in the CRM; off, it is refused.

fields.label: Allowed Fields
fields.description: The fields this contract may send and read. Leave empty to allow all of them. The phone number is always allowed.

name: CRM Lead API Mapping
